source_summary: Ink-wash Chinese landscape with a high cloud-veiled mountain, distant ridges, layered mist, and foreground wooded hills. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: cloud_veiled_main_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the dominant upper central mountain mass: a tall rounded peak with steep shoulders, pale interior washes, darker contour accents, and horizontal texture strokes along ridges and summit.
must_preserve: soft grey ink wash forming the peak volume
dark broken horizontal cun texture strokes on the crest and side ridges
vertical wash streaks down the right face
mist-softened lower edge where the mountain dissolves into cloud
irregular rounded summit silhouette

motifs.name: left_foothill_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left connected ridge beneath the main mountain, including the dark sloping knoll and small pale background peaks behind it.
must_preserve: dark clustered horizontal brush dashes on the left knoll
soft pale wash of distant peaks behind the ridge
low undulating ridge contour
mist-blurred transitions at the base
scattered dry-brush rock texture

motifs.name: right_distant_peaks
motifs.description: Isolate the faint distant mountain group at the right side of the middle distance, behind the main peak base.
must_preserve: very light ink wash silhouettes
two rounded peak forms
soft atmospheric edges
minimal dark contouring
hazy recession into background mist

motifs.name: middle_mist_band
motifs.description: Isolate the broad horizontal band of mist and vapor crossing the painting below the main mountain, with soft openings and cloud-like wash patches.
must_preserve: pale unpainted cloud gaps
soft grey feathered wash edges
horizontal drifting structure
blurred submerged hill shapes within the vapor
uneven ink density suggesting layered fog

motifs.name: central_misty_islets
motifs.description: Isolate the small middle-ground hill and islet forms emerging from mist in the center-lower area.
must_preserve: rounded low hill silhouettes
soft diluted ink washes
barely visible contours fading into mist
subtle layered depth between overlapping forms
gentle horizontal base strokes

motifs.name: left_foreground_bamboo_hill
motifs.description: Isolate the left foreground mound with its rounded rock face, dark dashed ridge texture, and sparse bamboo or shrub strokes along the slope.
must_preserve: bold dark horizontal texture dashes on the crest
rounded pale rock wash on the hill face
small thin bamboo-like leaf clusters
soft base wash at the foot of the hill
dry-brush contour accents

motifs.name: central_pine_grove_mound
motifs.description: Isolate the central foreground wooded mound with a dense stand of straight dark trunks and layered horizontal foliage strokes.
must_preserve: vertical dark tree trunks of varying thickness
stacked horizontal pine-needle strokes
misty grey wash behind the grove
rocky mound base with broken texture marks
small grass tufts at the lower edge

motifs.name: right_foreground_pines_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the right foreground rocky slope and cliff with tall pines, slender saplings, bamboo-like foliage, and the pale vertical cleft or stream cut through the rock.
must_preserve: tall dark pine at far right with layered needle clusters
slender central saplings with fine leaves
rounded cliff and boulder washes
dark broken texture marks along the slope
pale vertical cleft or waterfall-like white channel
small bamboo-like shrubs near the lower right

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
